title: Context removal / commonization framing study

arms.description: Scientific source, variant and provenance are visible.
The identical phenotype is shown without source identity/provenance until after response.

principle: Operational analogy to sadharanikarana/commonization: test the effect of removing particularizing scientific context. This is not a claim to directly measure rasa or Abhinavagupta's construct.
notes: The underlying source bundle and interpretation genome are identical across framing conditions.
Rasa response is retrospective and optional.
Confirmatory runs require fresh viewers and fresh phenotypes after hypotheses are frozen.
